We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Project Manager to lead our stormwater management initiatives in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. In this role, you will oversee all aspects of project planning, execution, and delivery for stormwater infrastructure projects. You will work collaboratively with engineering teams, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. This position requires a professional who can make decisive decisions, manage complex timelines, and maintain meticulous project documentation.
Oversee end-to-end project lifecycle management for stormwater infrastructure projects, from planning through completion
Develop comprehensive project plans, schedules, and budgets; monitor progress and implement corrective actions as needed
Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams including engineers, contractors, consultants, and government agencies to ensure seamless project execution
Manage project budgets, track expenditures, and implement cost control measures to maintain financial accountability
Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks; develop contingency plans to address potential challenges
Prepare and maintain detailed project documentation, reports, and technical specifications
Conduct regular stakeholder meetings and provide progress updates to senior management and clients
Ensure compliance with local regulations, environmental standards, and safety protocols specific to UAE projects
Manage contracts and vendor relationships to optimize project delivery and resource allocation
Monitor project quality standards and implement quality assurance procedures throughout all project phases
q: Minimum 10 years of professional project management experience, with at least 5 years in stormwater or civil infrastructure projects
Proven experience as a Project Management Consultant (PMC) or in a similar project oversight capacity
Strong knowledge of stormwater management systems, drainage infrastructure, and civil engineering principles
Demonstrated expertise in budget management, cost estimation, and financial forecasting
Proficiency in project management tools and software (Microsoft Project, Primavera, or equivalent)
Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with attention to detail
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills
Experience working on projects in the United Arab Emirates or Middle East region is highly desirable
Familiarity with UAE building codes, environmental regulations, and local compliance requirements
Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 certification is preferred
Knowledge of AutoCAD or other design software is advantageous
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and adapt to changing project requirements

d: Company Description Muscat Kitchen Appliances is a retail business specializing in a wide range of kitchen and home appliances for residential and commercial customers. The company focuses on offering reliable, high-quality products that meet diverse cooking and lifestyle needs. Muscat Kitchen Appliances aims to create a welcoming in-store experience with knowledgeable staff who help customers make informed purchasing decisions. The team values professionalism, integrity, and service excellence, and provides ongoing training to support employee growth.

Role Description This full-time, on-site Retail Salesperson role is based in Muscat and involves assisting customers throughout their shopping experience. Day-to-day responsibilities include greeting customers, understanding their needs, and recommending suitable kitchen appliances and related products. The Retail Salesperson will demonstrate product features, provide clear and accurate information on specifications and pricing, and process sales transactions using the store’s systems. The role also includes maintaining a clean and organized sales floor, restocking shelves, and updating product displays to support promotional activities. The Retail Salesperson will handle basic customer inquiries, support after-sales service, and collaborate with team members to achieve individual and store sales targets.
q: Candidates should possess strong Retail Sales and Sales skills, with the ability to meet targets and close sales effectively.
Candidates should possess solid Product Knowledge related to kitchen appliances and be willing to learn about new product lines.
Candidates should possess excellent Communication and Customer Service skills to interact professionally with diverse customers.
Previous experience in retail or appliance sales, basic computer literacy, and comfort using point-of-sale systems are beneficial.
A high school diploma or equivalent, reliability in working scheduled shifts, and the ability to stand for extended periods are required.
Strong teamwork, problem-solving abilities, and proficiency in English; additional local language skills are an advantage.
